messages:
Tasha: Quick sanity check who9s keen for a "Controller Swap" LAN this Saturday? Idea: everyone brings one weird/retro controller and we rotate matches. Low-key prizes for the most absurd controller. :trophy: :joy:
Leo: Love this. I have an old Dreamcast VMU controller adapter thats hilariously unwieldy  count me in.
Mina: Im in if we can do some Steam co-op (Overcooked 2?) and then blindfolded-button-challenge with the weird controllers lol.
Owen: Sounds chaotic in the best way. Ill bring my Retro-Bit Genesis pad and an extra Switch Pro. Also happy to handle a small bracket for anyone who wants it.
Tasha: Perfect. Logistics: start 18:30, office common room. Bring controllers, chargers, HDMI adapters. Policy reminder: no alcohol on premises.
Leo: Question: do we want wired LAN or just rely on Wi-Fi? For Rocket League and Overcooked Id prefer wired.
Mina: Wired please if possible. I can bring a 15ft Cat6 and a power strip.
Owen: Ill bring a second monitor and a couple ethernet cables. Also can someone bring snacks? I promise not to bring kale chips. :grimacing:
Tasha: @Leo you on snack duty? 
Leo: I got chips + cookies. Any dietary restrictions?
Mina: Gluten-free option appreciated.
Tasha: Noted. Also poll: React with :one: for "Retro controller exhibition", :two: for "Tournament with weird controllers", :three: for "Casual free-play".
Mina: :two: :smirk:
Owen: :three: but down for exhibition matches too.
Leo: :one: for maximum chaos.
Tasha: OK leaning tournament + exhibition. Calendar created.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Controller Swap LAN Night" Saturday 18:30 Office Common Room
